items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Takes $930 Million Equity Stake In A Private Tech Company
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.A) has taken a significant equity stake in Bending Spoons valued at about US$930m. The capital injection gives Berkshire a direct ownership position in the technology group rather than providing debt financing. This single company equity move marks a fresh capital allocation step for Berkshire into a privately held tech operator.
